snippet.title: A Brand New Indie Game Boy Color Game! - Mouseman: Point-and-Click RPG Adventure - Debut Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the demo on itch.io, Steam and more! https://leech.games

The debut of Mouseman: Point-and-Click RPG Adventure - A brand new indie Game Boy Color game!
Mouseman brothers Chester and Lester are strapped for Cheddah, and rent was due yesterday! Luckily, Lester has a plan... and it's up to Chester to carry it out!
Discover the hidden secrets of New Cat City, but don't get swallowed up by the mean streets in this black comedy noir point and click RPG adventure that calls back to the classics you know and love!

Play the demo on Newgrounds! (Supports Gamepads and most mobile touchscreen devices)
https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/project/7324873

Free demo ROM downloadable on Itch.io! (Playable on Emulators, Flashcarts and more!)
https://ralphnemesis.itch.io/mouseman

Game and trailer -  @RalphNemesis 
Trailer music - "G-Activate" - @NicholasPetris 
3D Animation - @olifromsolly1 
Announcer Voice - @the_parvinator 
Cover art - @ultra_aka_ross (Png) on X

Leech Games is a group of gamers turned devs who make cool and fun video games

Join the Leech Games community discord server to follow the development of Mouseman and future games! We would love to hear your thoughts and feedback! 
https://discord.gg/2rVWmPYma5
